'''2024 Retro Online Championship Series Playoffs''' (ROCS) was the Players Committee retro OCS playoff on GEMP, December 2024. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-11-retro-online-championship-series-rocs-playoffs-dec-2024/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' December 2024
